visualization.title: Pharma companies and drugs in industry-led multiple myeloma trials

meta.interpretation: Interventional multiple myeloma trials led by industry sponsors, to identify which pharma companies are developing drugs and which drugs appear in those trials.
assumptions: A trial can have several values of intervention, so counts can sum to more than the trials.
warnings: Network shows the 40 most frequent of 1431 values.

chain.rationale: Interventional multiple myeloma trials led by industry sponsors, to identify which pharma companies are developing drugs and which drugs appear in those trials.
